sources.summary: Synchronous per-object transactions, durable storage synchronization and PITR; not cross-object atomicity.
Use bounded coordination atoms; a single pilot budget authority is a scoped tradeoff, not a general scaling claim.
Server policy hook, unsigned/final intent boundary and per-transaction payment cap; durable reservation sequencing and exact SDK semantics still need source/runtime qualification.
Explicit sponsor mode, native/USDM alternatives and online merchant; pilot permits native TESTETH only and does not execute the installer.
EIP-712 and ERC-1271 documented; nested initialized/fresh consent and actual safe mint remain UNRUN.
Official testnet faucet reference; actual faucet/RPC match to6343 not established by this page.
Total gas includes compute and storage; estimate exact calls on MegaETH.
Documented limits include mainnet-configured parameters; not proof of current testnet capacity.
Receipt gas and optional L1 fee fields, null and unsealed placeholder behavior; canonical safe verification remains required.
MegaETH testnet support for Turbo/Subgraphs; project, dataset, costs and destination unconfigured.
Account nonce by block; documented gateway treats pending as latest. Supporting observation only, not proof of the transaction that consumed a nonce or current testnet behavior.
Ordinary EVM typed transaction and sender-nonce equality; not proof of provider replacement policy or MOSS intent cancellation.
